   if(t.group==='viewerGround')light=1;
   const sx=((M[0]*wx+M[4]*wy+M[8]*wz+M[12])*.5+.5)*size,sy=((M[1]*wx+M[5]*wy+M[9]*wz+M[13])*.5+.5)*size,sz=(M[2]*wx+M[6]*wy+M[10]*wz+M[14])*.5+.5;
   if(sx>1&&sx<size-2&&sy>1&&sy<size-2){const xi=sx|0,yi=sy|0,idx=yi*size+xi,bias=.002,amount=(softwareShadow[idx]+bias<sz?1:0)+(softwareShadow[idx+1]+bias<sz?1:0)+(softwareShadow[idx+size]+bias<sz?1:0)+(softwareShadow[idx+size+1]+bias<sz?1:0);light-=amount*.035;}
   if(t.pattern===2){const ix=Math.floor(wx*95),iz=Math.floor(wz*95),hash=((ix*73856093)^(iz*19349663))>>>0;light*=.94+(hash%128)/127*.10;}
   if(t.pattern===3)light*=1+Math.sin(wz*170+Math.sin(wx*8)*2)*.025+Math.sin(wz*32)*.025;
   if((t.pattern===1&&Math.abs(n[1])>.5)||t.pattern===4){let u=wx,v=wz,cell=.5;if(t.pattern===4){cell=.30;if(Math.abs(n[1])<.5){u=Math.abs(n[0])>.5?wz:wx;v=wy;}}const fu=((u/cell)%1+1)%1,fv=((v/cell)%1+1)%1,edge=Math.min(fu,1-fu,fv,1-fv);if(edge<.011){const mix=(.011-edge)/.011*.60,grout=t.pattern===4?54:234;rr=rr*(1-mix)+grout*mix;gg=gg*(1-mix)+grout*mix;bb=bb*(1-mix)+grout*mix;}}
   const j=i*4;if(blend){pixels[j]=pixels[j]*(1-alpha)+rr*light*alpha;pixels[j+1]=pixels[j+1]*(1-alpha)+gg*light*alpha;pixels[j+2]=pixels[j+2]*(1-alpha)+bb*light*alpha;}else{softwareDepth[i]=depth;pixels[j]=rr*light;pixels[j+1]=gg*light;pixels[j+2]=bb*light;}
  });
 }
 for(const t of opaque)renderOne(t,false);
 const sorted=[...transparent].sort((a,b)=>{const depth=t=>t.p.reduce((v,p)=>v+dot(sub(p,lastCamera.eye),lastCamera.forward),0);return depth(b)-depth(a)});for(const t of sorted)renderOne(t,true);
 softwareContext.putImageData(softwareImage,0,0);ctx.setTransform(canvas.width/width,0,0,canvas.height/height,0,0);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.drawImage(softwareCanvas,0,0,width,height);
 if(window.__viewerDebug)window.__viewerDebug.frameMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);
}

function drawLabels(){const layer=$('#labels');layer.style.display=state.labels||state.selected?'':'none';for(const el of layer.children){let r=roomMap[el.dataset.room],show=(state.labels||state.selected===r.id)&&(state.garden||r.id!=='garden');el.hidden=!show;if(!show)continue;const p=project([r.center[0],.3,r.center[1]]);el.style.left=p[0]+'px';el.style.top=p[1]+'px'}}
function render(){frame=0;if(!dirty)return;dirty=false;width=Math.max(1,stage.clientWidth);height=Math.max(1,stage.clientHeight);let dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),w=Math.round(width*dpr),h=Math.round(height*dpr);if(canvas.width!==w||canvas.height!==h){canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h}updateCamera();if(needsGeometry)buildGeometry();if(gl)drawGL();else drawCanvas();drawLabels()}
function requestDraw(){dirty=true;if(!frame)frame=requestAnimationFrame(render)}
try{initializeGL()}catch(error){gl=null;const old=canvas;canvas=old.cloneNode(false);old.replaceWith(canvas);ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');$('#fallbackNote').style.display='block';window.__viewerFallbackReason=String(error.message||error);$('#fallbackNote').title=window.__viewerFallbackReason;console.warn('3D viewer graphics fallback:',window.__viewerFallbackReason);}
function setView(view){
 const oldView=state.view;if(view==='top'&&oldView!=='top'){previousOrbit={yaw:state.yaw,elev:state.elev};state.yaw=0;state.elev=TOP_ELEVATION;}else if(view!=='top'&&oldView==='top'){state.yaw=previousOrbit.yaw;state.elev=previousOrbit.elev;}
 state.view=view;document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.view===view)));
 $('#viewDescription').innerHTML=view==='top'?'평면 보기 <b>도면 치수 기준</b>':view==='cut'?'단면 보기 <b>'+Math.round((DATA.cutHeightM||1.08)*1000).toLocaleString()+'mm에서 절단</b>':'전체 높이 <b>'+Math.round((DATA.wallHeightM||2.7)*1000).toLocaleString()+'mm · 가정값</b>';
 $('.stage-footer .desktop-only').textContent=view==='top'?'드래그 이동 · 휠 확대':'드래그 회전 · 휠 확대 · 오른쪽 드래그 이동';
 canvas.setAttribute('aria-label',view==='top'?'평면 주택 모델. 드래그로 이동, 스크롤로 확대':'3D 주택 모델. 드래그로 회전, 스크롤로 확대, 오른쪽 드래그로 이동');needsGeometry=true;requestDraw();
}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setView(b.dataset.view));$('#resetView').onclick=()=>{selectRoom(null);state.scale=1;state.target=[...CAMERA_ANCHOR];state.yaw=.53;state.elev=1;previousOrbit={yaw:.53,elev:1};setView('full')};$('#rotateView').onclick=()=>{state.yaw+=Math.PI;requestDraw()};const zoom=amount=>{state.scale=Math.max(.3,Math.min(3,state.scale*amount));requestDraw()};$('#zoomIn').onclick=()=>zoom(.85);$('#zoomOut').onclick=()=>zoom(1/.85);
for(const [id,key] of [['toggleFurniture','furniture'],['toggleWindows','windows'],['toggleGarden','garden'],['toggleLabels','labels']])$('#'+id).onchange=e=>{state[key]=e.target.checked;if(key!=='labels')needsGeometry=true;requestDraw()};
function inPolygon(x,z,p){let inside=false;for(let i=0,j=p.length-1;i<p.length;j=i++){const A=p[i],B=p[j];if((A[1]>z)!==(B[1]>z)&&x<(B[0]-A[0])*(z-A[1])/(B[1]-A[1])+A[0])inside=!inside}return inside}
function pick(x,y){if(!lastCamera)return;const {eye,forward,right,up,hw,hh}=lastCamera,nx=x/width*2-1,ny=1-y/height*2,origin=eye.map((v,i)=>v+right[i]*nx*hw+up[i]*ny*hh);if(Math.abs(forward[1])<.001)return;const t=-origin[1]/forward[1],p=origin.map((v,i)=>v+forward[i]*t);let r=DATA.rooms.find(r=>inPolygon(p[0],p[2],r.poly));if(r&&(!state.garden&&r.id==='garden'))r=null;selectRoom(r?.id||null)}
let pointers=new Map(),lastGesture=null,clickStart=null,wheelActive=false,wheelTimer=0;
function gesture(){const ps=[...pointers.values()];if(ps.length>=2){let A=ps[0],B=ps[1];return{type:'pinch',x:(A.x+B.x)/2,y:(A.y+B.y)/2,d:Math.hypot(A.x-B.x,A.y-B.y)}}if(ps.length===1)return{type:state.view==='top'||ps[0].pan?'pan':'rotate',x:ps[0].x,y:ps[0].y};return null}
function pan(dx,dy){if(!lastCamera)return;const amount=lastCamera.hh*2/height;for(let i=0;i<3;i++)state.target[i]+=-dx*amount*lastCamera.right[i]+dy*amount*lastCamera.up[i]}
canvas.oncontextmenu=e=>e.preventDefault();canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);pointers.set(e.pointerId,{x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,pan:e.button===2||e.shiftKey});lastGesture=gesture();if(pointers.size===1)clickStart={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,time:Date.now(),ok:e.button===0};else clickStart=null;});canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!pointers.has(e.pointerId))return;const old=pointers.get(e.pointerId);pointers.set(e.pointerId,{...old,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY});const g=gesture();if(clickStart&&Math.hypot(e.clientX-clickStart.x,e.clientY-clickStart.y)>5)clickStart.ok=false;if(g&&lastGesture&&g.type===lastGesture.type){let dx=g.x-lastGesture.x,dy=g.y-lastGesture.y;if(g.type==='rotate'){state.yaw-=dx*.007;state.elev=Math.max(.16,Math.min(Math.PI/2-.001,state.elev+dy*.006))}else if(g.type==='pan')pan(dx,dy);else{state.scale=Math.max(.3,Math.min(3,state.scale*(lastGesture.d/Math.max(1,g.d))));pan(dx,dy)}requestDraw()}lastGesture=g;});canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{if(clickStart?.ok&&Date.now()-clickStart.time<500&&pointers.size===1){let box=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();pick(e.clientX-box.left,e.clientY-box.top)}pointers.delete(e.pointerId);lastGesture=gesture();clickStart=null;requestDraw();});canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',e=>{pointers.delete(e.pointerId);lastGesture=gesture();clickStart=null;requestDraw();});canvas.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();wheelActive=true;clearTimeout(wheelTimer);wheelTimer=setTimeout(()=>{wheelActive=false;requestDraw()},180);zoom(Math.exp(Math.max(-180,Math.min(180,e.deltaY))*.0015))},{passive:false});canvas.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','+','-','=','0'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();if(state.view==='top'){if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')pan(24,0);if(e.key==='ArrowRight')pan(-24,0);if(e.key==='ArrowUp')pan(0,24);if(e.key==='ArrowDown')pan(0,-24);}else{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')state.yaw-=.12;if(e.key==='ArrowRight')state.yaw+=.12;if(e.key==='ArrowUp')state.elev=Math.min(1.569,state.elev+.1);if(e.key==='ArrowDown')state.elev=Math.max(.16,state.elev-.1);}if(e.key==='+'||e.key==='=')zoom(.9);if(e.key==='-')zoom(1.1);if(e.key==='0')$('#resetView').onclick();requestDraw()}});
canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost',e=>{e.preventDefault();$('#modelStatus').textContent='그래픽 복구 중'});canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextrestored',()=>{initializeGL();needsGeometry=true;requestDraw()});
let referenceIndex=0,returnFocus=null;REFERENCES.forEach((r,i)=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='reference';b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-label',r.title+' 크게 보기');let img=document.createElement('img');img.src=r.src;img.alt=r.title;let span=document.createElement('span');span.textContent=r.shortTitle||r.title;b.append(img,span);b.onclick=()=>openReference(i);$('#referenceGrid').append(b);let tab=document.createElement('button');tab.textContent=r.shortTitle||r.title;tab.onclick=()=>showReference(i);$('#referenceTabs').append(tab)});
function showReference(i){referenceIndex=(i+REFERENCES.length)%REFERENCES.length;const r=REFERENCES[referenceIndex];$('#referenceImage').src=r.src;$('#referenceImage').alt=r.title;$('#referenceTitle').textContent=r.title;[...$('#referenceTabs').children].forEach((b,j)=>b.classList.toggle('active',j===referenceIndex))}function openReference(i=0){returnFocus=document.activeElement;showReference(i);$('#referenceOverlay').classList.add('open');$('#closeReferences').focus()}function closeReference(){$('#referenceOverlay').classList.remove('open');returnFocus?.focus()}$('#openReferences').onclick=()=>openReference(1);$('#closeReferences').onclick=closeReference;$('#referenceOverlay').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='referenceOverlay')closeReference()};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!$('#referenceOverlay').classList.contains('open'))return;if(e.key==='Escape')closeReference();if(e.key==='ArrowRight')showReference(referenceIndex+1);if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')showReference(referenceIndex-1);if(e.key==='Tab'){const buttons=[...$('#referenceOverlay').querySelectorAll('button')],i=buttons.indexOf(document.activeElement);e.preventDefault();buttons[(i+(e.shiftKey?-1:1)+buttons.length)%buttons.length].focus()}});
new ResizeObserver(requestDraw).observe(stage);requestDraw();
})();
</script>
</body>
